title: 第27章 上古炼气士，真实存在！ 他们，误闯天家！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
“林薇队长下令，对玉棺进行无损探查！最后的谜底，即将揭晓！”

    演播厅里，冰冰的声音也因为紧张而微微有些颤抖。

    所有人都知道，这口玉棺，就是整个淮南死域谜团的核心。

    它里面的东西，将决定这次考古发现的最终性质。

    究竟是超乎想象的古代文明遗物，还是……

    真的与“神仙”有关？

    现场，两名队员立刻上前，小心翼翼地架设起一台便携式的“量子雷达扫描仪”。

    “这是我们目前能带到地下的，最精密的探测设备。”

    陈振博士主动解释道，“它可以通过发射亚原子粒子束，穿透物体，并根据反馈，构建出物体内部的三维立体影像，精度可以达到纳米级别。理论上，棺材里哪怕有一根头发丝，都逃不过它的扫描。”

    【量子雷达！听着就高大上！】

    【快快快！我已经迫不及待想看棺材里到底是什么了！】

    【千万别是空的啊！那我得郁闷死！】

    【我赌一包辣条，里面躺着一个穿着宇航服的外星人！】

    【我赌里面是淮南王刘安，而且还活着！】

    弹幕里，各种猜测层出不穷，观众们的热情被彻底点燃。

    设备很快准备就绪。

    “开始扫描！”

    林薇一声令下。

    “嗡——”仪器启动，一道肉眼看不见的粒子束，射向了那口悬浮在光柱中的玉棺。

    所有人都紧紧地盯着队员手中的显示屏，等待着扫描结果的出现。

    然而，三秒钟过去了。

    五秒钟过去了。

    十秒钟过去了。

    显示屏上，依旧是一片空白，没有任何影像生成。

    “怎么回事？”

    林薇皱起了眉头。

    操作仪器的队员额头上冒出了冷汗，他反复检查着设备，声音都有些发颤：“不……不知道啊队长！仪器显示一切正常，粒子束已经发射了，但是……但是没有任何反馈信号！就像……就像被什么东西给吞噬了一样！”

    “被吞噬了？”
content_en:
"Captain Lin Wei ordered a non-destructive inspection of the jade coffin! The final answer to the mystery will be revealed soon!"

    In the studio, Bingbing's voice trembled slightly due to nervousness.

    Everyone knows that this jade coffin is the core of the mystery of the Huainan Death Zone.

    What's inside will determine the ultimate nature of this archaeological discovery.

    Is it an unimaginable relic of ancient civilization, or...

    Is it really related to "gods"?

    At the scene, two team members immediately stepped forward and carefully set up a portable "quantum radar scanner".

    "This is the most sophisticated detection equipment we can bring underground."

    Dr. Chen Zhen took the initiative to explain, "It can emit subatomic particle beams, penetrate objects, and based on feedback, construct a three-dimensional image of the interior of the object. The accuracy can reach the nanometer level. Theoretically, even a hair in the coffin cannot escape its scanning."

    【Quantum Radar! It sounds grand! 】

    【Quick, quick, quick! I can't wait to see what's in the coffin! 】

    【Don’t leave it empty! Then I will be depressed to death! 】

    [I bet there is an alien in a space suit inside a pack of spicy strips! 】

    [I bet it’s Huainan King Liu An inside, and he’s still alive! 】

    In the barrage, various speculations emerged one after another, and the audience's enthusiasm was completely ignited.

    The equipment is quickly ready.

    "Start scanning!"

    Lin Wei gave an order.

    "Buzz--" The instrument started, and a particle beam invisible to the naked eye shot towards the jade coffin suspended in the light beam.

    Everyone stared closely at the display screen in the hands of the team members, waiting for the scan results to appear.

    However, three seconds passed.

    Five seconds passed.

    Ten seconds passed.

    The display screen was still blank, with no image generated.

    "What's going on?"

    Lin Wei frowned.

    Cold sweat broke out on the forehead of the team member operating the instrument. He checked the equipment repeatedly, his voice trembling: "No... I don't know, Captain! The instrument shows that everything is normal, the particle beam has been emitted, but... but there is no feedback signal! It's like... it's like being swallowed by something!"

    "Devoured?"
title_en: Chapter 27 Ancient Qi Refiners really existed! They accidentally broke into Tianjia!
